prompt:
Edit the supplied two-screen CLEAN TUNER app mockup. Preserve the upper UI and warm frosted champagne silver / ivory palette, headers, instrument selectors, tuning selectors, three-note range arches, readouts and bottom listening status. The user rejects the photoreal AI-looking guitar headstocks. COMPLETELY REPLACE BOTH headstocks with an exceptionally restrained abstract STRING SELECTOR diagram. No guitar silhouettes, no tuning pegs, no screws, no shiny chrome, no modeled hardware, no strings converging into a neck.

Lower panel design: a flat precise instrument diagram that looks like a premium engineered UI graphic, six evenly spaced parallel vertical strings for Guitar and four evenly spaced parallel vertical strings for Ukulele. Each string is one thin charcoal hairline from y roughly 610 to 760, delicate slightly different weights on guitar decreasing from left to right. Flat orthographic, no perspective. Each string is separately tappable in its broad invisible column. Tiny precision terminal dots at ends, subtle warm ivory surface, very minimal quiet recessed horizontal guide at bottom only. Above each string is its note name in clean medium typography. Below each string is a tiny string number. Clear open space around each column, no keycaps or big buttons. Amber highlight only on selected string, a subtle halo tightly around this thin straight string and a tiny amber dot at its lower end; selected note label charcoal, perhaps slightly heavier. No waves, no frets, no sliders or knobs. This is a beautiful abstract functional diagram resembling strings on a precise modern instrument faceplate; premium tactile materials are in the surrounding panel, diagram itself is crisp and deliberately graphic. Do not fill unused area with controls.

EXACT left-to-right guitar columns:
E₂ / A₂ / D₃ / G₃ / B₃ / E₄.
EXACT small string numbers left-to-right underneath:
6 / 5 / 4 / 3 / 2 / 1.
Highlight only second column A₂, string 5, in amber.
EXACT left-to-right ukulele columns:
G₄ / C₄ / E₄ / A₄.
EXACT small string numbers underneath:
4 / 3 / 2 / 1.
Highlight only second column C₄, string 3, in amber.
Keep small AUTO above each string array. Preserve -8 ct FLAT on left and 0 ct IN TUNE on right. Improve left actual pitch marker to be only slightly left of A₂ center, about 4 degrees off center, not halfway to edge. Preserve all other upper note labels and styling. High resolution polished visual design mockup. No explanatory copy, no extra screens.
review: Correct string counts, notes, indices and selected columns. Left pitch marker remains illustrative rather than calibrated to -8 cents.
